plain_language_scope: Build a visual and photometric reference from all approved confirmed UCDs and the published Saifollahi high-probability candidate subset.

cohort_definitions.saifollahi_high_probability_candidate: Accepted canonical objects from Saifollahi et al. 2021 tablea6.dat; these remain candidates, not confirmed UCDs.

gaia_membership_policy: Test NSS, galaxy-candidate, and QSO-candidate membership only by one exact literature Gaia DR3 source identifier.
legacy_tractor_policy: Query within 2 arcseconds of each literature coordinate, retain every nearby match, and record nearest and second-nearest separations before selecting the closest row for per-object summaries.
legacy_image_policy: Request one 64-by-64 ls-dr10 JPEG at 0.262 arcseconds per pixel for every coordinate and preserve unavailable or unusable outcomes explicitly.
